ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line segment $AC$ intersects line segment $BD$ at point $O$. If $\angle A = 70^\circ$, $\angle B = 30^\circ$, $\angle C = 60^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle AOB = \angle COD$,\\
it follows that $\angle A + \angle B = \angle C + \angle D$,\\
given $\angle A = 70^\circ$, $\angle B = 30^\circ$, and $\angle C = 60^\circ$,\\
thus $70^\circ + 30^\circ = 60^\circ + \angle D$,\\
therefore, $\angle D = \boxed{40^\circ}$.
